item.title: 1245 E Colfax Avenue Listed for $12M as Entitled Development Site - Naked Denver
item.description: A fully entitled, 144-unit micro-apartment development at 1245 E Colfax Avenue is listed for $12 million after the site's previous owner defaulted and lender Lead Funding took over, completed entitlements, and is now seeking a developer-buyer for the shovel-ready mixed-use project in City Park West.

item.title: Summit FC and Broncos Advance Stadium Plans in Same Week - Naked Denver
item.description: Denver saw two major stadium updates this week as Summit FC closed on its future stadium site and the Broncos clarified key financial and timing details for Burnham Yard.

item.title: City Park Bandstand Damaged by Thursday Fire, Donations Open - Naked Denver
item.description: A Thursday morning fire damaged the City Park Bandstand, and a local neighborhood organization is collecting donations to support rebuilding efforts.

item.title: From Office Suites to Loft Living: Inside Viewpoint 41's Transformation in Virginia Village - Naked Denver
item.description: Viewpoint 41 Lofts is a 41-unit apartment community in Denver's Virginia Village neighborhood, converted from a 1963 office building into modern studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences managed by Cornerstone. The property stands as an early example of the office-to-residential adaptive reuse trend now reshaping Denver's built environment, with a central location steps from the King Soopers at Colorado Boulevard and easy access to I-25.

item.title: Summit FC Draws 63,004, Sets WMSL Attendance Record at Empower Field - Naked Denver
item.description: Summit FC set a WMSL attendance record with 63,004 fans at Empower Field. Discover how this milestone boosts professional soccer in Denver.

item.title: Apiary Residences | Elevated Living at Belleview Station - Naked Denver
item.description: Apiary Residences offers a new standard of living in Denver's Tech Center. Experience luxury, convenience, and connection in this vibrant community.

item.title: Highland Place II Returns to Market After Failed Repositioning - Naked Denver
item.description: A Centennial office deal that once looked like a major discount is back on the market as leasing challenges and capital costs reshape the investment outlook.

item.title: 24 Loft Units Proposed at Former Housing Authority and Church Building - Naked Denver
item.description: A 24-unit loft-style development is proposed at 1425 Kalamath, a site with a layered history as a housing authority office, long-term vacancy, and former church use.

item.description: Douglas County commissioners approved a contract with KT Development to deliver the Zebulon Regional Sports Complex, advancing a major youth sports investment tied to voter approved funding.

item.description: Four Denver-based finalists have been named for the 2026 James Beard Awards, reinforcing the city’s growing national reputation as a top-tier food destination.
